properties.name: AGGREGATE_VCF_EXCERPT_ENABLED
properties.description: Enables VARIANT_LIST queries that return aggregate (non-patient-level) VCF excerpt data. Treated as enabled whenever VCF_EXCERPT_ENABLED is true, since full excerpt access implies aggregate access; on its own, false disables aggregate VCF excerpt queries.

properties.name: CACHE_SIZE
properties.description: Maximum number of phenotype concept PhenoCube objects kept in the Guava in-memory cache used by AbstractProcessor and the v3 PhenotypicObservationStore. Concepts beyond this count are evicted and reloaded from the phenotype data store on next access.

properties.name: CHILD_CONCEPT_CACHE_SIZE
properties.description: Maximum number of entries in PhenotypeMetaStore's child-concept-path lookup cache, which speeds up repeated lookups of every concept path nested under a given concept path.

properties.name: HPDS_DATA_DIRECTORY
properties.description: Filesystem directory containing the phenotype data store files (columnMeta.javabin, allObservationsStore.javabin) that AbstractProcessor and the v3 PhenotypicObservationStore read. The path is concatenated directly with each file name, so it must end with a trailing slash.

properties.name: HPDS_GENOMIC_DATA_DIRECTORY
properties.description: Filesystem directory containing the genomic variant data that GenomicProcessorConfig loads, for the local, localDistributed, localPatientDistributed, and localPatientOnlyDistributed genomic processor implementations.

properties.name: ID_BATCH_SIZE
properties.description: Number of patient IDs processed per batch when a processor partitions its result set for export. In TimeseriesProcessor and TimeseriesV3Processor a value of 0 (the default) disables data export entirely, since runQuery then throws because export is not authorized. In QueryProcessor, MultiValueQueryProcessor, QueryV3Processor, and MultiValueQueryV3Processor the value is instead passed directly to Guava's Lists.partition as the batch size.

properties.name: ID_CUBE_NAME
properties.description: Name of a phenotype concept whose per-patient values are substituted for the internal patient ID in VariantListProcessor and VariantListV3Processor export output. NONE (the default) disables the substitution, so the raw internal patient ID is used.

properties.name: TARGET_STACK
properties.description: Deployment stack identifier that DictionaryService substitutes into the ___TARGET_STACK___ placeholder inside dictionary.host to build the dictionary API base URL. Blank or unset (the default) leaves the placeholder in the host string unreplaced.

properties.name: VCF_EXCERPT_ENABLED
properties.description: Enables VCF excerpt queries that return patient-level variant data in VariantListProcessor and VariantListV3Processor VARIANT_LIST results. Enabling it also implicitly enables AGGREGATE_VCF_EXCERPT_ENABLED, since full excerpt access implies aggregate access.

properties.name: data-export.s3.bucket-name
properties.description: Name of the S3 bucket SignUrlService uploads data export files to and generates presigned download URLs against. Empty by default, meaning no bucket is configured until a deployment sets one.

properties.name: data-export.s3.region
properties.description: AWS region of the S3 bucket SignUrlService uses for data export uploads and presigned URL generation.

properties.name: data-export.s3.signedUrl-expiry-minutes
properties.description: Number of minutes a presigned S3 download URL generated by SignUrlService remains valid before it expires.

properties.name: dictionary.host
properties.description: Base URL template of the dictionary API that DictionaryService calls to fetch concept details. May contain a ___TARGET_STACK___ placeholder that TARGET_STACK fills in. DictionaryService is only created when this property is set, via @ConditionalOnProperty.

properties.name: hpds.genomicProcessor.remoteHosts
properties.description: List of remote genomic processor host addresses that the remote genomic processor bean in GenomicProcessorConfig fans queries out to. Only read when hpds.genomicProcessor.impl is set to remote.

properties.name: hpds.requireAuthorizationFilter
properties.description: Controls whether QueryValidator requires every v3 query to carry at least one authorization filter. True (the default) rejects a query with no authorization filter; set to false only when patient data access is controlled some other way.

properties.name: variant.info_column_order
properties.description: Comma-separated list of genomic info column names defining the sort order ColumnSorter applies to variant info columns. Blank or unset (the default) leaves columns unsorted and unfiltered; when set, any column not named in the list is dropped from the sorted output.
